methods.whenToUse: Use browser sign-in for the provider-hosted MCP server.
methods.guidanceMd: Connect Glasser in the browser. A Glasser account for browser sign-in, or a Glasser Key from app.glasser.ai/keys; every run is billed at the endpoint's published price.
methods.label: Sign in with Glasser
warnings: A Glasser account for browser sign-in, or a Glasser Key from app.glasser.ai/keys; every run is billed at the endpoint's published price.

methods.whenToUse: Use a restricted customer-owned key when browser sign-in is not suitable.
methods.guidanceMd: Use a customer-created Glasser key. A Glasser account for browser sign-in, or a Glasser Key from app.glasser.ai/keys; every run is billed at the endpoint's published price.
methods.label: Use an API key
warnings: A Glasser account for browser sign-in, or a Glasser Key from app.glasser.ai/keys; every run is billed at the endpoint's published price.
